Set seven years after the events of Neuromancer, Count Zero returns to a world already changed by artificial intelligence. It follows a mercenary, a young console cowboy and an art dealer whose separate stories begin to reveal what happened to the intelligence that emerged at the end of the first novel.

In this video, I look at Count Zero’s strange evolution of cyberpunk: the gods appearing in cyberspace, the relationship between art and memory, and the difference between Josef Virek’s pursuit of immortality and the mysterious machine making boxes in orbit. Spoilers for Neuromancer and Count Zero.
